verdict.rationale: Docs mention an 'Insights' feature to 'measure and optimize your team's developer productivity' (graphite-docs-13/17), implying some dashboard capability, but there is no evidence of specific metrics like findings counts, AI-review acceptance rates, or review-coverage tracking across the org. Missing for 10: detail on what Insights actually measures (acceptance rates, findings volume, coverage %), screenshots/docs of the dashboard UI, and any independent confirmation it delivers org-wide visibility.
